title: Decision JM-5: depend on crate-jmap by git rev pin
description: mimid depends on crate-jmap (JMAP Chat types and jmap_server dispatch) by an exact git rev pin to github.com/MarkAtwood/crate-jmap, like the openmls and mls-rs pins. It needs a pushed crate-jmap commit containing the jmap-mimi types (.12.2); each crate-jmap write still needs Mark's approval.
notes: REVERSED by Mark 2026-10-19: mimid now tracks crate-jmap branch = "main" (no rev pin); breaking changes surface at build time.
